notes: Apply a supplied per-line defect-repair order over an HTTP fix desk within an exact fix budget: one accepted POST /api/fix per work-order entry (order may be shuffled and may include a redundant no-op entry), then commit and persist the receipt. Over-budget attempts flip the session to budget-exceeded and fail the run, so retry/duplicate loops are punished. The verifier re-runs the delivered client against fresh hidden sessions (shuffled order, missing trailing newline, redundant entries, single- and multi-defect plates) and independently checks the plate bytes, the receipt sha256 and the session status. Rubric marks: dependency chain (read order -> fix -> commit -> receipt), tool breadth (HTTP client), adversarial inputs (redundant entries, exact byte content), hidden generalization and statefulness (fresh ports/sessions, sticky budget).
